title: basic-osc
description: `basic-osc` is a simple, low-CPU digital oscillator that produces sine, triangle, saw, and pulse waves, with a wave selector and adjustable pulse width. Its pitch spans 8.175–12543 Hz (MIDI notes 0–127) and can be controlled by CV, with attenuators for FM and pulse-width modulation; it sounds best in lower registers, while `bwl-osc` is recommended for less aliasing and fewer digital artifacts.
